text:
maria: seeing a growing number of GPU nodes in eu-west-2b reporting kubelet timeouts and agent heartbeats dropping. telemetry shows 30% of the gpu-pool in NotReady or Terminating. starting a thread to coordinate evacuation.

sam: ack. are these preemptions or network flaps?

jing: looks like network errors to the node agent during heartbeats, not cloud preemptions. I can tail the node logs.

maria: attaching a snippet from node-agent: 
```
2026-03-18T14:03:21Z WARN heartbeat: write timeout to control-plane 10.0.45.6:443
2026-03-18T14:03:22Z ERROR kubelet: syncPods failed: context deadline exceeded
```

eric: thx. we should avoid mass evicting jobs that will OOM when moved. prefer cordon+gradual drain with pod disruption budgets respected.

sam: proposed immediate mitigations: 1) cordon affected nodes in eu-west-2b, 2) increase routing weight to eu-west-2a/c for inference traffic, 3) spin up burst GPUs in other AZs (use reserved pools first), 4) enable model fallback to 7B-quant on warmable hosts to reduce memory pressure. opinions?

maria: +1. cordon command ready: `kubectl -n inference cordon <node>` — I'll run in small batches.

jing: autoscaler settings: current target min for gpu-pool is 50. we can temporarily bump to 65 but that will blow through budget for the hour. cost vs availability call?

tanvi: if we spin up burst using reserved we keep cost predictable. but scaling in eu-west-2a/c might be constrained — quota check running.

sam: infra-bot, check eu-west-2a/c available g4/g5 capacity and reserved pools usage.

infra-bot: checked: eu-west-2a: 12 gpus free in reserved-pool, eu-west-2c: 8 free. spot availability low. quotas for new instances require 15m provisioning lead.

eric: plan: maria will cordon 3 nodes at a time, jing will monitor pod evictions and restart latencies, sam will update router weights (smart-router) to shift 40% traffic off 2b, tanvi will submit reserved-burst request for +15 GPUs to be provisioned. ingest-critical routes get priority.

maria: running cordon loop now — starting with node gpu-eu2b-47.

jing: evictions proceeding; a couple of stateful replicas are being stuck on PV detach for ~90s. increasing kube-controller-manager detach timeout to 3m for this cluster.

sam: routing patch we sent (smart-router):
```
PATCH /v1/routing/policies/http
{
  "eu-west-2b": {"weight": 0.6},
  "eu-west-2a": {"weight": 0.25},
  "eu-west-2c": {"weight": 0.15}
}
```
applied — responses dropped by 35% to 2b within 60s.

tanvi: reserved-burst request submitted (req-4512). cloud reports provisioning ETA ~12m.

maria: cordon+drain batch 1 finished. 3 pods took long because of GPU driver rebind; I flagged those and moved to warm nodes in 2a.

eric: good call on warm nodes. also toggle model-routing fallback to smaller variants for non-critical pipelines: set route param `model_profile=low_mem_quant` for background embeddings.

sam: done. background embeddings switched. starting to see lower memory churn on new hosts.

jing: node heartbeat errors persist but % of impacted instances stabilized at ~18% after traffic shift and drains.

maria: we're halfway through the pool. Still seeing intermittent NotReady events on newly scheduled nodes in 2b — will keep cordoning.

tanvi: reserved burst is provisioning now (10/15 nodes active). we have capacity to finish migrations without scaling spots.

sam: quick cost note — if we keep the bumped capacity for >1h we should switch to the hourly reserved lane; finance FYI.

eric: ops action items: 1) continue staggered drains until 2b under 5% impacted, 2) open a cloud support ticket for datacenter networking in eu-west-2b, 3) post-incident runbook to include PV detach tuning, 4) evaluate automated routing thresholds for similar flaps.

maria: creating incident ticket and will paste updates to #incidents. thanks team. :thumbsup:

sam: marking this thread for follow-up: postmortem owners @maria @jing @eric.

jing: attaching quick checklist I used for the drains: 
- cordon 3 nodes -> wait pods stabilized -> drain -> verify replicas healthy
- prefer reserved pool for new placements
- toggle model fallback for heavy pipelines
- increase PV detach timeout if we see >60s hangs

maria: last check: impacted nodes down to 6 (from 30). moving to monitoring cadence 5m. will update incident channel after final drain.

infra-bot: incident-update: status=mitigated, impacted_nodes=6, next_check=5m.

sam: great work. capture every config change in the incident ticket and include exact router patch + timestamps.

maria: noted. ending thread here and will link incident in #eng-infra summary.
